additional_implementation_choices: Numerical palette, layout and times follow the final shot plan; concrete SVG path vertices, book line lengths, eye ellipse radii and arm quadratic curves are builder realization.
Body is a rounded trapezoid and two feet in one scalable group; eyes remain in that same group at fixed horizontal distance.
Ten book line groups are nine page groups plus the independent target as group seven. The same paragraph is never replaced with a duplicate during transfer.
A 3px no-fill target outline appears before the paragraph travels. The target paper path has 2px corner offsets.
Arms use rigid translation from y=-10 to y=0 instead of unsupported SVG path morphing. This is a technical realization of continuous hand movement; tactile credibility is not pre-validated.
Book pages have explicit zero-coordinate vertices so the planned top-left scale origin is not dependent on a nonzero path bounding box.
Fixed 8px SVG patterns supply low-opacity paper dots on procedural surfaces; no particle, glow or free-floating decoration is added.
Local @font-face references the supplied private TTC; no visible explanatory text is added.
No registry block is added. The final plan records the authorized catalog audit and reuse of existing GSAP/SVG technical primitives.

recipe_execution.scope: One geometric silhouette with fixed eye spacing and paper-dot pattern.
Initial book/body contact arrangement and final smaller task above hands.
Same paragraph travels; same book retreats; body scales around its foot position.

unmet_requirements: Actual keyframes and six-second playback are still required to verify perceived pressure, hand contact, posture and identity tracking.
The supplied recipes do not specify numerical shapes, pivots, layout or timing; these are executor additions recorded here and in shot-plan.
Psychological pressure remains a visual metaphor without any medical or factual capability claim.
